points.K2: 能升华的固体可用来纯化

shots.scene: 欣欣站在电热板旁，板上是盖着皿盖的培养皿，皿盖上放着一杯冰水，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a hot plate holding a covered glass dish topped with a beaker of ice water, and waves at the camera.
shots.narration: 这一课讲升华纯化。

shots.scene: 固体直接变成气体、再在冷处结晶的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a solid turning directly into vapor, then forming crystals on a cold surface above. No people.
shots.narration: 固体变气体，遇冷再结晶。

shots.scene: 阿杰把电热板旋钮拧到最大，培养皿里的样品冒烟发黑
shots.prompt_en: The young male student turns the hot plate knob all the way up and the sample in the petri dish smokes and turns black.
shots.narration: 阿杰想快点，把热板开到最大。

shots.scene: 烧黑的样品图标被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a blackened sample in a dish, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 样品烧焦了，白忙一场。

shots.scene: 小研把旋钮调到很低
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student turns the hot plate knob down to a very low setting.
shots.narration: 小研说：升华要小火、要耐心。

shots.scene: 冰块化成水和固体直接冒出气体两个对比图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons compared: an ice cube melting into water, and a solid giving off vapor directly with no liquid. No people.
shots.narration: 固体不经熔化，直接变成气体。

shots.scene: 欣欣指着冒出蒸气的固体图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points at an icon of a solid releasing vapor.
shots.narration: 这就叫升华。

shots.section_title: 能升华的固体可用来纯化
shots.scene: 温度计上熔点线下方，固体已有蒸气冒出
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer with a melting point line; below the line the solid already gives off vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 熔点以下就有明显蒸气压的固体，
overlay: 能升华的固体可用来纯化

shots.section_title: 能升华的固体可用来纯化
shots.scene: 粗样变成纯晶体的箭头
shots.prompt_en: A crude brownish powder turning into bright pure crystals with an arrow. No people.
shots.narration: 才能升华，可以用来纯化。

shots.scene: 常压升华装置图，旁边一个减压装置小图标
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of an open sublimation setup at normal pressure, with a small vacuum setup icon beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 本课演示常压升华。

shots.scene: 两种装置之间一个等号
shots.prompt_en: The two setups with an equal sign between them. No people.
shots.narration: 减压升华，原理和步骤也一样。

shots.scene: 分子变成气体再变回晶体，结构不变
shots.prompt_en: A molecule icon becomes vapor and then a crystal again, keeping the same shape, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 条件一：升华和凝结时不分解。

shots.scene: 目标分子飞上去，杂质颗粒留在原处
shots.prompt_en: Target molecule icons rise up while impurity particles stay behind at the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 条件二：杂质在同样条件下不升华。

shots.scene: 电热板、培养皿底、培养皿盖、冰水烧杯四个部件
shots.prompt_en: Four parts laid out: a hot plate, a glass dish bottom, a glass dish lid, and a beaker of ice water. No people.
shots.narration: 电热板、培养皿、皿盖、冰浴。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起大拇指
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot gives a thumbs up beside the simple setup.
shots.narration: 就这么简单。

shots.scene: 小研戴手套，用刮刀把棕色粗样转进培养皿
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student, wearing gloves, uses a spatula to transfer brownish crude powder into a glass dish.
shots.narration: 先把粗样转进培养皿。

shots.scene: 刮刀把粉末摊平，旁边一个厚度标尺
shots.prompt_en: A spatula spreads the powder evenly, with a small thickness ruler beside it. No people.
shots.narration: 摊开摊平，哪里都不超过5毫米。

shots.scene: 培养皿放到电热板上，盖上皿盖
shots.prompt_en: The dish is set on the hot plate and covered with its glass lid. No people.
shots.narration: 放到电热板上，盖上皿盖。

shots.scene: 一杯冰水放在皿盖上
shots.prompt_en: A beaker of ice water is placed on top of the dish lid. No people.
shots.narration: 皿盖上放一杯冰水当冰浴。

shots.scene: 手指把旋钮调到很低的位置
shots.prompt_en: A finger turns the hot plate knob to a very low mark. No people.
shots.narration: 加热开到很低。

shots.scene: 沙漏图标旁的装置
shots.prompt_en: The setup next to an hourglass icon. No people.
shots.narration: 耐心等着。

shots.scene: 旋钮开到最大、样品发黑的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a knob at maximum and a blackened sample, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 加热过头，样品就毁了。

shots.scene: 皿盖下表面出现亮黄色晶体
shots.prompt_en: Bright yellow-orange crystals form on the underside of the dish lid below the ice beaker. No people.
shots.narration: 条件合适，皿盖上很快长出晶体。

shots.scene: 晶体长成一层，手指关闭加热
shots.prompt_en: A layer of crystals has grown; a finger switches off the heat. No people.
shots.narration: 长成一层，就关掉加热。

shots.scene: 温度计图标指针下降
shots.prompt_en: A thermometer icon beside the setup with its level dropping. No people.
shots.narration: 先让装置稍微冷一冷。

shots.scene: 冰水烧杯被轻轻从皿盖上滑开
shots.prompt_en: The ice water beaker is gently slid sideways off the dish lid. No people.
shots.narration: 再把冰浴轻轻滑开。

shots.scene: 皿盖粘在烧杯底被一起提起、晶体掉落的图标被打叉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of the lid stuck to the beaker bottom being lifted together, crystals falling off, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 小心，皿盖可能粘在烧杯底上。

shots.scene: 手按住皿盖，烧杯平移离开
shots.prompt_en: A hand holds the lid down while the beaker slides away. No people.
shots.narration: 一不小心，晶体就全掉了。

shots.scene: 小研轻轻揭开皿盖，盖下一层闪亮晶体
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student carefully lifts the lid to show a layer of shiny crystals underneath.
shots.narration: 小心揭盖，纯净的晶体出现了。

shots.scene: 刮刀把晶体刮到干净表面皿上
shots.prompt_en: A spatula scrapes the crystals from the lid onto a clean watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 把晶体刮到干净的表面皿上。

shots.scene: 左边棕色带黑点的粗样，右边亮橙色晶体
shots.prompt_en: Left: a brownish crude powder with dark specks. Right: bright orange crystals, with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 和粗样比一比，干净多了。

shots.scene: 表面皿上只有少量晶体
shots.prompt_en: Only a small amount of crystals on the watch glass. No people.
shots.narration: 第一批不多，别着急。

shots.scene: 盖回皿盖、放上冰浴、重新开低热
shots.prompt_en: The lid goes back on, the ice beaker on top, and the heat is turned back on low. No people.
shots.narration: 盖好、放冰浴、重新加热收下一批。

shots.scene: 循环箭头图标，表面皿上的晶体越来越多
shots.prompt_en: A cycle arrow icon while the pile of crystals on the watch glass grows. No people.
shots.narration: 重复几次，直到全部纯化。

shots.scene: 欣欣手捧空白讲义
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a thick blank lab manual.
shots.narration: 演示只是预习，讲义一定要读。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现不分解、杂质不升华两个图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside two floating icons: an intact molecule and impurities staying behind.
shots.narration: 不分解、杂质不升华，才能用升华。

shots.scene: 铺薄的粗样、皿盖、冰浴、低温旋钮图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a thin layer of crude solid, a dish lid, a beaker of ice water and a low heat knob. No people.
shots.narration: 铺薄、盖好、放冰浴、小火慢热。

shots.scene: 冷却、滑开、揭盖、刮晶体四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: cooling, sliding the beaker away, lifting the lid and scraping crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 先冷却，再滑开冰浴，小心揭盖。

shots.scene: 循环箭头和越来越多的晶体图标
shots.prompt_en: A circular arrow icon next to a watch glass with a growing pile of crystals. No people.
shots.narration: 一批一批收，直到全部纯化。

shots.scene: 欣欣举起盛着橙色晶体的表面皿，挥手道别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds up a watch glass of bright orange crystals and waves goodbye at the camera.
shots.narration: 小火慢慢来，晶体自然来，下次见！
